verify.invalidLink: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired.

setup.title: MindSift first-time setup
setup.subtitle: Initial administrator account & server configuration
setup.welcome: Welcome to your new MindSift instance. There is no user account in the database yet. Create the first server admin account now and choose the security settings.
setup.codeHint: It is in the server's log, e.g. <c>docker logs mindsift</c>; a restart makes a new one.
setup.languageHint: For the sign-in page and new accounts; everyone can pick their own language later.
setup.privateHint: Nobody sees other users. Sharing and groups are off.
setup.organizationsHint: Users only see members of their organization. You start in an organization named after the instance.
setup.openHint: Open collaboration across the whole server.
setup.allowRegistrationHint: When off, new users can only join with an invite code or be created by an admin.
setup.backupsHint: Every day a snapshot of the whole database and one backup per person under <c>data/backups/</c>. You can change this later in the administration.
setup.backupsCopyHint: The backups are on the same server as the data: copy the <c>data/backups/</c> folder to another place regularly as well.
setup.backupTimeMissing: Please choose a time for the backups.
setup.sampleDataHint: Fills your account with sample thoughts, notes, task lists and shopping lists to try things out. No other users are created.
setup.finishWelcome: Your administrator account {{username}} was created at startup from ADMIN_USER and ADMIN_PASSWORD. Now choose the instance settings; you can change all of them later in the administration.

setupMail.emailHint: Recommended: without an address there is no "Forgot password", and email alarms have nowhere to go. It only counts once you click the link in the confirmation mail; until then you sign in with your username.
setupMail.configure: Set up the mail server now
setupMail.configureHint: For "Forgot password", confirmation links, invitations and email alarms. You can also skip it.
setupMail.skippedHint: Later under your profile picture → Administration → Email / SMTP server.
setupMail.envSet: Mail server set up by the environment (SMTP_HOST)
setupMail.envSetHint: Change it in the .env file or under Administration → Email / SMTP server.
setupMail.hostMissing: Please enter the SMTP server or switch off "Set up the mail server now".
setupMail.testSent: Test mail sent to {{email}}. Check your inbox, and the spam folder if need be.
setupMail.testLater: You can send a test mail after finishing, under Administration → Email / SMTP server.

setupSummary.nothingOpen: Nothing open: mail server and BASE_URL are set up.
setupSummary.noMail: No mail server: no "Forgot password", no confirmation links, invitations or alarms by email. Set it up under profile picture → Administration → Email / SMTP server.
setupSummary.noBaseUrl: BASE_URL is not set: emails cannot carry links (forgot password, address confirmation, invitations). Put the address of this instance into .env as BASE_URL and restart MindSift.
setupSummary.baseUrlOk: BASE_URL is set: links in emails lead to this instance.
setupSummary.noEmail: No email address: without one there is no "Forgot password". Add it under Account settings → Profile & security.
setupSummary.emailWaiting: {{email}} is noted down. You get the confirmation link as soon as the mail server and BASE_URL are set up; until then you sign in with your username.
setupSummary.emailLink: After finishing you get a confirmation link at {{email}}. Until you click it, you sign in with your username.
setupSummary.backups_one: Daily backups at {{time}}, kept for {{count}} day, in the folder {{dir}} (data/backups/ in a Docker installation). Also copy it to another place regularly (NAS, another computer): if this server fails, the backups are gone with it.
setupSummary.backups_other: Daily backups at {{time}}, kept for {{count}} days, in the folder {{dir}} (data/backups/ in a Docker installation). Also copy it to another place regularly (NAS, another computer): if this server fails, the backups are gone with it.
setupSummary.backupsOff: Daily backups are off. Switch them on under profile picture → Administration → Server & sharing.
setupSummary.admin: You can change all of this later under your profile picture → Administration.

login.registrationClosed: Public registration is disabled. Access only with an account or an <invite>invite code</invite>.
login.passkeyFailed: Signing in with the passkey did not work

register.hintApproval: After you register, an administrator approves your account.
register.hintVerify: You will get an email to confirm your address.
register.hintDomainApproval: Addresses from {{domains}} get in right away; an administrator approves other accounts.
register.hintVerifyFirst: {{hint}} You confirm your address by email first.
register.pending: Your account is waiting for an administrator's approval.

forgot.sent: If an account with this email address exists, we have sent you a link to reset your password. It is valid for one hour.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your account's email address. We will send you a link to set a new password.

reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password now.
reset.failed: The password could not be changed
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Afterwards you are signed out everywhere and sign in with the new password.

consent.title: {{client}} wants to access your MindSift
consent.signedInAs: Signed in as {{name}}. Access works as it does for you; settings stay locked.
consent.returnTo: Afterwards you return to {{host}}. The connection is listed under Settings → API keys, where you can revoke it at any time.
consent.otherAccount: Sign in with a different account
consent.unknownHost: Careful: once allowed, access goes to {{host}}. That is none of the known AI services (claude.ai, chatgpt.com) and not your own computer. Anybody can call themselves “{{client}}” – only allow this if you set up the connection yourself.

mfa.title: Two-step confirmation
mfa.intro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.introRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works only once.
mfa.trustHint: Signing in here then asks for no code. Only on your own devices.
mfa.recoveryUsed_one: Recovery code used. You have {{count}} code left.
mfa.recoveryUsed_other: Recovery code used. You have {{count}} codes left.
mfa.recoveryLow: Make new codes in the settings under “Security” before they run out.
mfa.recoveryNone: That was your last recovery code. Make new codes in the settings under “Security”.
mfa.introPasskey: Confirm the sign-in with your passkey: fingerprint, face or device PIN.

mfaRequired.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
mfaRequired.intro: The administration requires two-factor sign-in for your account. Set up an authenticator app or a passkey, then carry on as usual.
mfaRequired.continueHint: You can continue once the app or a passkey is set up.

oidc.emergency: Emergency access for administrators: signing in with a password is otherwise switched off.

error.expired: The sign-in has expired or was started in another browser. Please try again.
error.unavailable: {{name}} cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.
error.failed: Signing in with {{name}} did not work. Please try again or contact the administration.
error.noAccount: There is no MindSift account for your {{name}} account, and only the administration creates new accounts.
error.noEmail: {{name}} sent no verified e-mail address. Without one MindSift creates no account; please contact the administration.
error.pending: Your account is still waiting for an administrator's approval.
error.unverified: Please confirm your e-mail address first using the link we sent you.
error.setup: MindSift has not been set up yet.
error.wrongAccount: You signed in to {{name}} with a different account than the one linked to your MindSift account.
error.notFresh: {{name}} did not ask you to sign in again. Please sign out there and try again.
error.linkedElsewhere: This {{name}} account is already linked to another MindSift account.
error.alreadyLinked: Your account is already linked to {{name}}.
